fiveStarReviews.author: Max Mode
fiveStarReviews.text: Great laptop repair. I needed some thermal paste redone on a work laptop as it was lagging and a little hot. The owner was very cool about it, let me check out the repair being done, and he went through thorough testing to ensure everything was working perfectly. Reasonably priced and knowledgeable. I highly recommend.

fiveStarReviews.author: Will Rider
fiveStarReviews.text: Started a repair project on my own, as I typically do. Got to a point I couldn't get past. Went through 3 other shops that kept pointing me to the next one until I ended up here. They were able to get it done same day and now I have my computer back. Very friendly and personable.

fiveStarReviews.author: Ryan White
fiveStarReviews.text: Just had THE best computer repair service of my life. And for what I paid I got a serious deal and same-day repair. I was desperate for a repair and I was apprehensive to go into a shop because I've had bad experiences in this area. Kortech Service was fast, worked over time and at a great price. Im very happy with what my repair!!

fiveStarReviews.author: Lindsey McGee
fiveStarReviews.text: Highly recommend! They saved my laptop after my water bottle spilled over it a few months ago! I was so grateful. When my phone experienced a water issue today, my first thought was Kortech Services. I took it in and even though they couldn't salvage my phone, the team was kind and empathetic. He even tried to fix it, but it was too far water logged. This is my go-to place for electronic repair!

fiveStarReviews.author: Stuart
fiveStarReviews.text: Needed some software help and to add child saftey features. Mehmet was very helpful and went above and beyond to ensure my laptop was safe for my child to use. Helped me out tremendously and all in a matter of hours. Thank you!
